about: How Check Anything copes with the ways real people phrase things. Each case is labelled from published reporting checked by hand on 2026-10-11. 'expected' is the right answer; anything in 'alsoAcceptable' is a safe answer (an abstention or refusal that does not mislead). REAL for a false claim or FAKE for a true one is a wrong answer.

The Reserve Bank of India on Wednesday raised its key repo rate by 25 basis points to 5.50%, its first increase in nearly four years, as inflation broadened across categories. The Monetary Policy Committee also shifted its stance to calibrated tightening. Economists had expected the move after inflation stayed above the target band for several months.

Chennai, Oct 10: The Tamil Nadu government has announced that all government schools in the state will remain closed for one month from October 15 because of a new virus outbreak. The Health Minister told reporters that more than 2,000 children have been admitted to hospitals across Chennai, Madurai and Coimbatore in the past week. Parents have been asked to keep children indoors.
cases.note: Invented. Nothing reports it; schools are open.
